text:
Most of this session is sound. The new tests were shown to fail without the fixes (turns 48-52), and the phase test runs stayed limited to the named files (turns 46, 51, 55). The trouble came at the end, when the preview was run and then waited on.

- **Preview run twice (turns 63-68).** The first `self-check` ran in the background and was cut off at the default 10-minute limit (turn 67), so it had to be rerun. The step says to call the preview once.
- **Polling the background run (turns 65, 70, 72, 75-78).** The agent polled with `until ... sleep ...; cat` loops and read the task output from outside the workspace. These break the plain-single-command and stay-inside-the-directory limits. The polling also accounts for about 45 minutes of idle time with almost no tokens used.
- **Tests written after the fixes (turns 16-17, 28-29, then 43-45).** The source fixes went in before the tests. The agent did then show that the tests fail without the fixes (turns 49-51), which partly makes up for it.

I could not see whether the plan status, the triage note and the specs were handled, because the intent is cut and those steps may belong to earlier attempts.
